title: Partitioning a threshold filter
statement: Let $t$ assign a natural number to each element of a type, let $z$ be a natural number, and let $l$ be a finite list of such elements. The number of entries of $l$ for which $t(a)<z+1$ equals the number for which $t(a)<z$ plus the number for which $t(a)=z$.
